writers-of-the-future-q1-2027.generationPrompt: Create a landscape 3:2 editorial illustration for a FreeHub listing about a free science fiction and fantasy short story writing contest. Warm ivory paper, midnight blue ink, a pen beside handwritten pages, subtle imaginative stars and a small imagined distant planet emerging from the page. Refined hand-painted illustration, not a photograph. Do not imitate any competition logo or official campaign artwork; no prize money, trophies, brands, contest entry text or endorsement. Include a small clearly legible footer reading exactly 'FreeHub editorial illustration'. This is website editorial artwork, never an eligible contest entry.
